page.label: Friday, September 25
page.text: Before Mass, the Inquisition: Alex and Santino defend the Cathars, and Angela and Louisa defend the Church. Bring your notes. After Mass, the crusade against the Cathars and King St. Louis IX. Bring the list you wrote Monday, three things that made James I a great king.

page.label: This weekend
page.text: Nothing to read. Monday, September 28, is the Later Capetians.

page.label: Build a Guild
page.text: Three guilds formed Thursday, September 10: fishmongers, blacksmiths, and bakers. Keep your charter answers from class. Each guild will write out a full charter in its best calligraphy and bring in a masterwork of its trade. The dates will be posted here and in Educate.

glance.text: the Inquisition before Mass (Cathars against the Church); James I list after Mass.
charter and masterwork dates to come.

page.label: Due Friday, September 25
page.text: Read Matthew 24 to 28, the end of the Gospel. Annotate 26:6–16 and bring your discussion question.

glance.text: Matthew 24 to 28 read, 26:6–16 annotated, and your discussion question.

page.label: Friday, September 25
page.text: We read Canto XXIII together in class, and you get the study guide for Quiz 2. Nothing new is due.

page.label: Monday, September 28
page.text: Quiz 2 on Cantos XIV to XXIII, after the Mass pause. It moved from Friday. Short answers in complete sentences. Know each ring and ditch: the sin, the punishment and why it fits, and the people Dante meets there. The study guide is on this page.

page.label: Super Simile
page.text: Paragraphs 1 and 2 (the Charon birds, the Harpies) are in your folder. The folder stays in the room.

glance.text: Canto XXIII read together in class; the Quiz 2 study guide goes out.
Quiz 2, Cantos XIV to XXIII (moved from Friday).
Rehearsals Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, last period; the Friday sing at 1:23. The first all-school Friday sing was September 11.
